name: starpy
//image: The user's own curated base: non-root `developer` (UID 1000), passwordless sudo, zsh + dottod dotfiles, Nerd Fonts — the same shell as the workstation. Debian trixie, matching Dockerfile and CI.
//features: Two features, not three: `uv` manages the Python interpreter itself (`uv sync` provisions the version pyproject.toml requires), so a separate python feature would be redundant work — verified 2026-09-30. Both features come from one maintained org; versions come from .tool-versions (references/containers.md §3b).
//containerEnv: UV_LINK_MODE=copy: the uv cache lives on a volume and the workspace on a bind mount — different filesystems, so uv's default hardlinking always fails and warns on every sync.

initializeCommand.//: Seed .env once, from the example. Never overwrites an existing one — editing .env.example later does not refresh a live .env (see docs/product/devcontainer.md).

//postCreateCommand: A named volume is created root-owned, so `developer` cannot write into it on first run — chown once, permanently, rather than repeat a manual fix every rebuild. uv sync then provisions the interpreter (the ~35 MB download lands in the uv-data volume) and the dependencies.
//customizations: ruff is the project's formatter and linter (pyproject.toml [tool.ruff]) and ty the type checker — both set explicitly so no save diverges from CI (containers.md §3b: a formatter mismatch is a bug).
